summary: Sprint B retest - both UI regressions FIXED and verified. Unauthenticated /app/pricing renders all 4 tier cards without redirect to /login. Clicking Club CTA (unauth) correctly navigates to /login?next=/app/pricing. Admin login returns plan_tier='premium' plan_period='yearly' from /api/auth/me. On authenticated pricing view: Premium CTA='Formule actuelle' disabled, Free CTA='Formule actuelle inférieure' disabled, Club and Famille CTAs='Choisir cette formule' enabled. Mensuel/Annuel toggle works and 'Le plus populaire' badge persists on Famille tier.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint B pricing page complete. Both prior regressions (ProtectedRoute wrapping & missing admin plan_tier) fully verified fixed. Note: /api/auth/me includes plan_tier='premium' and plan_period='yearly' correctly. All 4 pricing CTAs behave per spec for both unauth and admin-premium users.
